subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Left and right: follows directions and describes position

show.line: Wave your right hand. Now wave your left hand. Left and right help us find things!

rounds.prompt: The ball is on the right of the boy. Which picture shows that?
rounds.praise: Yes! The ball is on his right.

rounds.prompt: Which girl is lifting her left hand?
The lion is on the left. The elephant is on the right. Where is the lion?
Kick the ball with your right foot! Which child kicks with the right foot?

hints: Hold up your hands. The left hand makes an L shape.
Your right hand is the one you wave with.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will lift my right hand.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Look, I lifted my left hand!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Right is the other hand.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: The left hand makes an L. The other one is right!
